from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486017/attempts/44ff304bb01845389149adac5e6f0a25/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full separator lines mark equal-sized panels.
    sep = next(c for c in range(1, 10) if sum(all(v == c for v in row) for row in grid) >= 1 and sum(all(row[j] == c for row in grid) for j in range(w)) >= 1)
    row_cuts = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    col_cuts = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    row_ranges = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]
    col_ranges = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cb) - 1)]
    # The non-background shape in a panel other than the first column is the stencil.
    stencil = None
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges[1:]:
            pts = [(i-r0, j-c0) for i in range(r0, r1) for j in range(c0, c1) if grid[i][j] not in (0, sep)]
            if pts:
                stencil = pts
                break
        if stencil is not None:
            break
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        c0, c1 = col_ranges[0]
        colors = [grid[i][j] for i in range(r0, r1) for j in range(c0, c1) if grid[i][j] not in (0, sep)]
        if not colors:
            continue
        color = max(set(colors), key=colors.count)
        if stencil is None:
            continue
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges:
            for i in range(r0, r1):
                for j in range(c0, c1):
                    out[i][j] = 0
            for di, dj in stencil:
                if r0 + di < r1 and c0 + dj < c1:
                    out[r0 + di][c0 + dj] = color
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-7303be46.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
print('saved',path)
